race.comment: Good little race. HANDEE (8) resumed with a dominant win at Caulfield Heath, controlling things up on speed and coming right away to score by 2.5 lengths. She has the run under the belt against a few dangers and maps for every chance again. WONDERFUL SKY (6) resumes. She looked good in three runs last time in, good in a G3 in Adelaide before a break. She was in a stronger race on Sunday and they opt for the softer option. MULL OF KINTYRE (10)  tried hard fresh as favourite against the older horses and should get every hope booting up from the inside gate. CAVILL AVENUE (9) won well on debut here and looks to have come back well, consider.
